XFlow.Name: w_upload_claims_to_incent
XFlow.Description: Mark Approved claims as Uploaded. Blank :v_claim_id uploads every approved claim; a value uploads just that one.

Method.Command:
UPDATE claim.claim_request
SET status = 'Uploaded',
    uploaded_flag = 'Y'
WHERE status = 'Approved'
  AND Nvl(uploaded_flag, 'N') <> 'Y'
  AND ( Nvl(:v_claim_id, '') = '' OR claim_id = :v_claim_id )

EXECUTION_NODE.Description: One UPLOAD row per claim, guarded against re-running

Method.Command:
INSERT INTO claim.claim_audit (
  audit_id, claim_id, action_name, from_status, to_status,
  action_by, action_date, comments
)
SELECT
  Concat('AUD-', Concat(c.claim_id, Concat('-', FormatDateTime(Now(), 'yyyyMMddHHmmss')))),
  c.claim_id,
  'UPLOAD',
  'Approved',
  'Uploaded',
  Nvl(:v_participant, ''),
  CurDate(),
  'Marked for Incent upload'
FROM   claim.claim_request c
WHERE  c.status        = 'Uploaded'
  AND  c.uploaded_flag = 'Y'
  AND  ( Nvl(:v_claim_id, '') = '' OR c.claim_id = :v_claim_id )
  AND  NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                    FROM   claim.claim_audit a
                    WHERE  a.claim_id    = c.claim_id
                      AND  a.action_name = 'UPLOAD' )
